hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" session codex'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" prompt codex'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || { [ -f "$r/.agents/config.yaml" ] || exit 0; echo "proofline: $h is missing; failing closed" >&2; exit 2; }; exec sh "$h" pretool codex'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" posttool codex'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" subagent-start codex'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || r=$PWD; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" subagent-stop codex'
